context:
Goal: reviews end as soon as a change is proven safe, and the rule text says what the merge tool does.
Problem (rule): the merge tool reads a guard or check change that failed round 1 and then passed its fix check as done (seen on #3399, 05:40 CST). The root CLAUDE.md rule roles-review-cap-three still says "Only a guard or check change fixed under a fix verifier also waits for round 3". Your R9 (18:35 CST Nov 13, "that's correct") says a fix after a pass ends review at the fix verifier's pass and round 3 runs only after a round 2 fail, and it names that root clause as stale, awaiting your yes. It does not name a fix after a round 1 FAIL. The tool has decided that case is covered. Only you can say which is right.
Based on (ruling): R9 and your answers on page items 739 and 741. Item 741's reply promised the stale clause "comes to you as its own yes"; triage found no such item on the page. Item 739 (a guard or check change that failed a round and passed its fix check: still round 3?) was withdrawn at 12:32 CST Nov 13 by the retrospective, with "Reopen if you want round 3 dropped for the fixed case too"; you never answered it.
Based on (measured, consultant's count, unchecked by triage): round 3 found a failure 0 of 14+ times after a clean round 2; the net-value hold after round 3 caught 6 real holes. Not measured: round 3 after a round 1 FAIL fixed under a fix check.
Departs from: main — the rule text makes a failed-then-fixed guard or check change wait for round 3; the tool does not. Option a rewrites the rule text to the tool; option b keeps the text and the tool changes.
Related sighting (coordinator 08:22 CST, relayed, unchecked by triage): claude-settings #3272 is replaced by draft #3403 under decision pr-review-record (a second fix after a fix check needs a fresh chain). One test-file fix after a round-3 PASS cost a new PR and three more rounds; the lane will report its time and CI cost. This is a different question (a second fix), shown here as the other side of the same cost.
Meanwhile: the tool decides (the coordinator told runner 11 so); no rule text changes until you answer.
No option is starred: a loosens what the rule text asks of a guard or check change, and triage has not measured the failed-then-fixed case.
home: step rounds-rules-one-record; ruling R9; items 739 and 741

options.gain: One rule everywhere; no round 3 and no extra head, lint and CI cycle after a fixed round 1 FAIL.
options.label: Done at the fix check pass: rewrite the root clause in place to match R9 and the tool
options.lose: A guard or check change that failed round 1 never gets a round 3 or the net-value test after it; the failed-then-fixed case is unmeasured.

options.gain: A failed guard or check change gets one more fresh read before it merges.
options.label: Round 3 still runs after a fix check pass on a guard or check change: keep the root text, and change the tool to ask for it
options.lose: The tool changes and every such change costs a new round, head, lane lint and CI cycle (unmeasured); the stale-clause rewrite for the fix-after-a-pass case is still needed.

owner: coordinator (session_013NEJL1gw6EdrSyvHkTUEx6), 05:44 CST Nov 14, from runner 10's `merge --reviewed` on #3399; posted by triage (session_013NEJKzCzoWhfP8FMCPtQU6)
short: After a guard change fails round 1 and passes its fix check, is it done, or does round 3 still run?
title: A guard or check change that failed round 1 and passed its fix check: is it done at the fix check, as the merge tool treats it and R9 reads (a), or does round 3 still run, as the root rule text says (b)?
why: The rule text and the tool disagree, and R9 does not name this case. A rule text that differs from the tool misleads every session that reads it.
